_about: GCX scheduled jobs — the single catalog Claude Mesh's Schedules menu reads. 'dir' is repo-relative; 'state' lists files/dirs (repo-relative or ~/…) that must move with a job when it switches between the Mac and the server; 'movable': false = needs something only one machine has. Schedules: {"every": minutes} or {"at": ["HH:MM", …], "days": [1-7 Mon=1] | null}.

jobs.name: Bad-review broadcast
jobs.what: Posts today's Pixel 11 · Galaxy Z8 · iPhone 18 1–3★ bad-review carousel to all 12 GCX Chat rooms. Holds the send if Z8 KR rows aren't tagged yet (the 11:00 retry sends it).

jobs.name: Bad-review broadcast · retry
jobs.what: If the 10:30 run was held back by the KR tagging gate, re-checks and sends the carousel.

jobs.name: Bad-review broadcast · catch-up
jobs.what: Sends today's carousel if the 10:30 run was missed (machine asleep/off). No-op once today is done.

jobs.name: Caspi 판매량 backfill
jobs.what: Fills the 판매량(EU) column in the iPhone 18 / Pixel 11 / Galaxy Z8 monitoring sheets from Caspi sales data. Self-gates to once per day per sheet.

jobs.name: 이염/변색 report
jobs.what: Mon/Fri ≥10:00: discoloration claims + bad reviews from Caspi, classified with claude -p, posted as a Chat report (runs every 30 min, sends once per due day).

jobs.name: SKU ↔ ASIN filler
jobs.what: Fills blank SKU/ASIN cells in the monitoring sheets by looking them up in Seller Central inventory (Chrome, Playwright).
jobs.pinnedReason: Needs the Seller Central inventory login (with OTP) in ~/.chrome-sc-inventory-profile — sign in on the server first.

sessions.name: Ticket monitor (Zendesk + TCT log)
sessions.what: Claude session looping the ticket-reporter skill: scans the two Zendesk pending views and the Lazada/Shopee TCT log, posts TCK pre-reports to Chat.

cloud.name: Google Apps Script triggers
cloud.what: MasterTrigger daily review distribution, TicketDailyReport 9AM, PurchaseDate_Sync 9AM/9PM, Monday↔Sheet syncs 17:00, MCF_Tracking, ABM_TicketMerge, TicketReporterCard Chat app — run in Google's cloud, need neither machine.
